subject: Discovery follow-up & demo scheduling - Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the call - next steps & demo slots

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for taking time today - really appreciate the context on Acme's analytics pipelines and the latency/cost constraints you mentioned. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: reduce per-query inference cost while keeping 95th pct latency under 120ms for your batch of 50k queries/day.
- Key success metrics: cost per 1k tokens, percent of queries hitting cache, and 95th pct latency.
- Items we need from your side: sample workload profile (anonymized), and a short list of attendees for the technical deep dive (network/security + infra/ML).

To keep momentum, can we lock a 45-minute technical demo/technical deep dive next week? Here are a few windows (I included times in PT):

- Tue 23 Jun - 10:00-10:45 PT
- Tue 23 Jun - 15:00-15:45 PT
- Wed 24 Jun - 11:00-11:45 PT

If none of those work, tell me the best two options and I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link. I’ll include our solutions engineer (Rishi) and our runtime lead.

Attached: brief one-pager outlining the demo agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_MVP_requirements.pdf (pdf)
